title: Student Assistant, Commercial Business Finance, Novonesis
description_md:
**Interesseret i en karriere, der gør en forskel?**




Do you want to rethink your impact, and are you passionate about analytics and business finance?

At Novonesis, we believe biological solutions can help solve some of the world’s biggest challenges. As a Student Assistant in Commercial Business Finance, you will join an international team that drives value creation through financial insights, analytics, and strong business partnering. This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience, influence business decisions, and collaborate with stakeholders across a global organization while developing your finance toolkit.

  

**The Role & Your Impact**

As a Student Assistant, you will support financial processes and strategic decision-making across the business. You will work closely with finance

professionals and commercial stakeholders, contributing analyses and recommendations that help drive performance and value creation. You will also gain exposure to senior leadership and participate in projects with real business impact.

  

**Your key responsibilities in this role:**

* Support financial planning, forecasting, and business review processes.
* Build analyses and generate insights for performance management.
* Contribute to business cases and strategic initiatives.
* Prepare presentations and decision-support materials for leadership teams.
* Drive and support projects with meaningful business impact.
* Collaborate with stakeholders across functions and geographies.

  

**What you'll need to be successful in this role**

We are looking for a motivated and analytical student who enjoys working with data, solving problems, and collaborating with others.

  

**Must-have qualifications:**

* Currently pursuing a degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* In the second half of your Bachelor's degree or the first half of your Master's degree.
* Strong analytical and structured approach to problem-solving.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.
* Ability to take ownership, work proactively, and engage with stakeholders.

  

**Key competencies:**

* Strong attention to detail.
* Analytical mindset.
* Structured way of working.
* Curiosity and learning agility.
* Collaboration and communication skills.

  

**Additional skills & interests we value**

While not required, the following qualifications will help you succeed and grow in the role:

* Experience with data management, visualization, or ETL tools such as SAP, Tableau, or KNIME.
* Interest in financial analysis and commercial business partnering.
* Curiosity and eagerness to learn in a dynamic environment.
* Strong collaboration skills across functions and cultures.
* Interest in sustainability, biotechnology, and biosolutions.

  

**What We Offer**

At Novonesis, you will join a collaborative and purpose-driven environment where learning and development are an integral part of everyday work. You will gain hands-on experience with core Business Finance processes and real business challenges while working alongside experienced colleagues and senior stakeholders.

The role offers significant exposure to global collaboration and the opportunity to apply your financial toolbox to real-life business situations. You will become part of a supportive team focused on development, knowledge sharing, and creating value together. The position is expected to be approximately 15-20 hours per week and may offer future opportunities for full-time employment upon completion of your studies.

  

**Ways of Working / Working Conditions**

This student position offers flexibility to accommodate your studies while providing meaningful professional experience. The role is based in Lyngby, Denmark, and includes collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders across global teams.

Hybrid working arrangements can be accommodated based on team needs. You should enjoy working in a dynamic and international environment where

priorities may change and where project-based work creates opportunities for continuous learning and development.

  

**Relevant information**

As part of your application, we kindly ask you to upload your academic transcript. We encourage applicants to apply without a cover letter or photo. Instead, please include a few lines in your CV explaining your motivation

for applying and what interests you about the role.

  

**Location:** Lyngby, Denmark

**Application deadline:** 2 October 2026

**Contact information:** For more information, please contact Senior Manager, Business Finance, Mads Lagoni at [MADPE@novonesis.com](mailto:MADPE@novonesis.com)

  

**Vores formål viser vejen**

I Novonesis ved vi, at løsninger forankret i biologi kan hjælpe med at løse verdens største udfordringer. Siden vi begyndte for mere end et århundrede siden, har dette været vores pejlemærke. Det er sådan, vi er nået så langt. Og det er sådan, vi vil påvirke fremtiden. Nu, mere end nogensinde, har verden brug for forandring. Og med biosolutions er mulighederne for transformation uendelige. Hvis vores formål giver mening for dig, opfordrer vi dig til at søge.

**Muligheder for alle**

Vi er dedikerede til en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces og lige muligheder for alle ansøgere. Derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte en ansøgning eller et foto og i stedet inkludere et par sætninger i dit CV, hvor du forklarer din motivation for at ansøge.

Vi træffer alle ansættelsesbeslutninger baseret på forretningsbehov og byder kandidater med en bred vifte af baggrunde velkommen, herunder etnicitet, religion, køn, seksuel orientering, alder, handicap eller veteranstatus.

**Udforsk andre stillinger**

Hvis denne stilling ikke passer til dig, kan du stadig finde andre muligheder hos os. Du er velkommen til at udforske ledige stillinger eller oprette en jobagent for at holde dig opdateret om fremtidige muligheder på [novonesis.com/Career](http://novonesis.com/Career).
